g.text: Grouped by residue class; median rho descending within groups. Descriptive only; no feature selection.
4/4 = all four terms share the sign; mixed = otherwise. Incomplete coverage is annotated.
Intervals show variation across clinical terms, not confidence intervals.
Association/correspondence only; no causal or mechanistic inference.
